name: front-door-audit
description: FRONT DOOR AUDIT (2026-09-08): every frontend, every port, every entry point across the ecosystem — live AND planned. All systems are being merged into ONE unified system. Three front doors: (1) the REAL one, (2) opencode GODMODE entrance (full creative access), (3) Quest 3 3D v-world. mem20 is the substrate AND includes HERSELF in the merge.

three_front_doors.door_2: opencode GODMODE entrance — full creative access terminal/agent
